scientific_integrity: The proof uses previously published exact innovation identities as input and proves a distinct necessary-and-sufficient criterion plus stretched-exponential variance phase diagram. All numerical checks are finite and are not substituted for analytic proofs.
scientific_limitations: For positive deterministic label-based attachment weights only. The threshold characterizes almost-sure plus L2 convergence, not all possible a.s. limits; distributional limits under nonquadratic scaling and random weights are not addressed. Originality may be subject to implicit coverage in earlier weighted-tree profile theory.
title: A square-summability criterion and two critical exponents for weighted recursive-tree path length
